question_groups.domain_description: Covers application inventory, patch management, workload/container security, and application security practices.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Vulnerable container images deployed to production with no visibility into what is running or what can be exploited.
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Implement container image scanning in the CI/CD pipeline to identify and block vulnerable images before they reach production, and mandate approved hardened base images for all container deployments.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No runtime protection. Compromised containers execute arbitrary code and move laterally without detection.
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy container runtime protection to monitor and detect malicious activity within running containers, and ensure alerts feed into the GSOC for investigation and response.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No complete application inventory; cannot protect what cannot be seen
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct immediate application discovery; build and maintain formal application catalog with ownership, criticality, and hosting environment

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: End of life applications remain in production with no vendor support or security patches
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Inventory all end of life applications, establish a remediation plan with defined timelines to replace or decommission each, and implement compensating controls to reduce exposure until replacement is complete

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No formal vulnerability management program. Blind to own expsosure
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a vulnerability scanning tool (tenable), establish a formal VM program with defined scanning cadence, prioritization, and remediation SLAs.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No patch management: critical vulnerabilities open for extended periods with no remediation timeline
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Implement a formal patch management process with defined SLAs and compliance reporting to track and enforce patching across the environment through Tanium.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Known critical vulnerabilities on internet systems which are exploited by automated tools within hours of disclosure
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a WAF immediately as a compensating control for internet-facing systems with known critical vulnerabilities, and establish an accelerated patching process to remediate critical vulnerabilities on internet-facing systems within defined SLA

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No application security testing and no penetration testing ever conducted
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct immediate pen test of internet applications and embed SAST/DAST into development pipeline

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No third party or open source component scanning. Known critical vulnerabilities go unidentified
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a Software Composition Analysis tool to scan all applications for third-party and open source component vulnerabilities, integrate scanning into the CI/CD pipeline to catch vulnerable dependencies before deployment, and remediate all critical findings on an accelerated timeline.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: APIs are not inventoried or tested, leaving the most exposed attack surface in the environment completely unassessed
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Inventory all APIs and include them in regular security testing through DAST and penetration testing

question_groups.domain_description: Covers third-party risk management, vendor onboarding controls, and ongoing vendor oversight.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Vendors with direct system and data access never assessed
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Audit all vendors with system or data access, require SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 and suspend access for vendors who cannot provide evidence. Ultimately, require all vendors to go through an assessment process prior to onboarding

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No vendor risk tiering. Highest-risk vendors receive the same scrutiny as low-risk ones
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Implement vendor risk tiering based on data sensitivity and access level and apply enhanced due diligence to high-risk vendors

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No maintained vendor inventory
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Immediately conduct a full discovery exercise to identify all third parties with access to MCD systems or data, establish a maintained inventory with risk tier classifications, and assign ownership for keeping it current on an ongoing basis

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Vendors are onboarded regardless of assessment results
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Immediately establish a formal assessment threshold with defined pass and fail criteria, implement a remediation and escalation process for vendors that do not meet the threshold, and suspend onboarding of any high-risk vendors currently in process until assessment requirements are met

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No vendor security assessments and are contractually unprotected and operationally blind
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct immediate vendor contract review, embed security requirements and data protection obligations in all vendor agreements

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No security requirements in vendor contracts. No accountability after a vendor-originated breach
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Update all vendor contracts to include security requirements, breach notification obligations, and right-to-audit clauses

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: MCD data flows to unreviewed sub processors outside MCD's visibility or control
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Require all vendors handling MCD data to disclose their sub processors, provide verification they have been vetted and update vendor contracts to include sub processor disclosure obligations and restrictions going forward

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Former vendors likely still have active access after engagement ended
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct vendor access review immediately, deprovision all inactive vendor accounts and implement formal vendor offboarding checklist

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No vendor incident monitoring so breaches affecting your data are discovered from the news, not the vendor
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Require contractual breach notification within 24-48 hours and implement continuous vendor security posture monitoring

red_flags.critical_gap: No complete inventory of cloud accounts and subscriptions
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy CSPM. Conduct a cloud account discovery exercise to identify all accounts, subscriptions, and tenants across all providers and establish a maintained inventory with defined ownership

red_flags.critical_gap: No complete picture of cloud deployments or publicly exposed resources
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a CSPM tool across all cloud accounts to continuously scan for misconfigurations and publicly exposed resources, and ensure all cloud accounts including those provisioned outside central IT are onboarded into the tool

red_flags.critical_gap: No security review of cloud architecture leading internet-facing systems deployed with no security input
red_flags.recommended_action: Establish mandatory security review for all cloud architecture decisions; implement cloud security design standards and guardrails

red_flags.critical_gap: No CSPM. Cloud storage and databases never checked for public exposure
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy CSPM tool and run initial scan for publicly exposed resources and remediate critical findings

red_flags.critical_gap: No IaC scanning. Misconfigurations reach production with no security check
red_flags.recommended_action: Implement IaC scanning in CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Checkov, tfsec); block deployments with critical misconfigurations

red_flags.critical_gap: Cloud audit logging not enabled and no logs retained or forwarded
red_flags.recommended_action: Immediately enable cloud-native audit logging across all cloud accounts and configure log forwarding to the GSOC

red_flags.critical_gap: No cloud alerts. High-risk events such as new admin roles and public bucket exposure go unnoticed
red_flags.recommended_action: Configure alerts for high-risk cloud events within the GSOC

red_flags.critical_gap: Vulnerable container images deployed to production with no visibility into what is running or what can be exploited.
red_flags.recommended_action: Implement container image scanning in the CI/CD pipeline to identify and block vulnerable images before they reach production, and mandate approved hardened base images for all container deployments.

red_flags.critical_gap: No runtime protection. Compromised containers execute arbitrary code and move laterally without detection.
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy container runtime protection to monitor and detect malicious activity within running containers, and ensure alerts feed into the GSOC for investigation and response.

red_flags.critical_gap: No complete application inventory; cannot protect what cannot be seen
red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct immediate application discovery; build and maintain formal application catalog with ownership, criticality, and hosting environment

red_flags.critical_gap: End of life applications remain in production with no vendor support or security patches
red_flags.recommended_action: Inventory all end of life applications, establish a remediation plan with defined timelines to replace or decommission each, and implement compensating controls to reduce exposure until replacement is complete

red_flags.critical_gap: No formal vulnerability management program. Blind to own expsosure
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a vulnerability scanning tool (tenable), establish a formal VM program with defined scanning cadence, prioritization, and remediation SLAs.

red_flags.critical_gap: No patch management: critical vulnerabilities open for extended periods with no remediation timeline
red_flags.recommended_action: Implement a formal patch management process with defined SLAs and compliance reporting to track and enforce patching across the environment through Tanium.

red_flags.critical_gap: Known critical vulnerabilities on internet systems which are exploited by automated tools within hours of disclosure
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a WAF immediately as a compensating control for internet-facing systems with known critical vulnerabilities, and establish an accelerated patching process to remediate critical vulnerabilities on internet-facing systems within defined SLA

red_flags.critical_gap: No application security testing and no penetration testing ever conducted
red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct immediate pen test of internet applications and embed SAST/DAST into development pipeline

red_flags.critical_gap: No third party or open source component scanning. Known critical vulnerabilities go unidentified
red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy a Software Composition Analysis tool to scan all applications for third-party and open source component vulnerabilities, integrate scanning into the CI/CD pipeline to catch vulnerable dependencies before deployment, and remediate all critical findings on an accelerated timeline.

red_flags.critical_gap: APIs are not inventoried or tested, leaving the most exposed attack surface in the environment completely unassessed
red_flags.recommended_action: Inventory all APIs and include them in regular security testing through DAST and penetration testing

red_flags.critical_gap: Vendors with direct system and data access never assessed
red_flags.recommended_action: Audit all vendors with system or data access, require SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 and suspend access for vendors who cannot provide evidence. Ultimately, require all vendors to go through an assessment process prior to onboarding

red_flags.critical_gap: No vendor risk tiering. Highest-risk vendors receive the same scrutiny as low-risk ones
red_flags.recommended_action: Implement vendor risk tiering based on data sensitivity and access level and apply enhanced due diligence to high-risk vendors

red_flags.critical_gap: No maintained vendor inventory
red_flags.recommended_action: Immediately conduct a full discovery exercise to identify all third parties with access to MCD systems or data, establish a maintained inventory with risk tier classifications, and assign ownership for keeping it current on an ongoing basis

red_flags.critical_gap: Vendors are onboarded regardless of assessment results
red_flags.recommended_action: Immediately establish a formal assessment threshold with defined pass and fail criteria, implement a remediation and escalation process for vendors that do not meet the threshold, and suspend onboarding of any high-risk vendors currently in process until assessment requirements are met

red_flags.critical_gap: No vendor security assessments and are contractually unprotected and operationally blind
red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct immediate vendor contract review, embed security requirements and data protection obligations in all vendor agreements

red_flags.critical_gap: No security requirements in vendor contracts. No accountability after a vendor-originated breach
red_flags.recommended_action: Update all vendor contracts to include security requirements, breach notification obligations, and right-to-audit clauses

red_flags.critical_gap: MCD data flows to unreviewed sub processors outside MCD's visibility or control
red_flags.recommended_action: Require all vendors handling MCD data to disclose their sub processors, provide verification they have been vetted and update vendor contracts to include sub processor disclosure obligations and restrictions going forward

red_flags.critical_gap: Former vendors likely still have active access after engagement ended
red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct vendor access review immediately, deprovision all inactive vendor accounts and implement formal vendor offboarding checklist

red_flags.critical_gap: No vendor incident monitoring so breaches affecting your data are discovered from the news, not the vendor
red_flags.recommended_action: Require contractual breach notification within 24-48 hours and implement continuous vendor security posture monitoring
